title: Escalation Bridgework Playbook for VIP Roadmap Requests
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Strategic customers escalate roadmap asks via EEs/AE/CSM channels with inconsistent data and no clear acceptance criteria, causing long decision loops and missed SLAs. Goal: Define a compact, repeatable playbook that converts VIP escalations into prioritized roadmap candidates with clear SLAs for intake, technical validation, and go/no-go decisioning. Scope: applies to escalations tagged as "VIP" or where projected ARR impact >= $200k or churn risk marked high by CSM. Out of scope: routine feature requests under the standard product request queue.
decision_log: 2025-09-12: PM team aligned on threshold criteria for VIP classification (ARR>=200k OR CSM churn_risk==high OR Exec escalation).
2025-09-18: Decided to require a lightweight technical feasibility check by Solutions Engineering within 5 business days before PM prioritization.
2025-09-25: Adopted a 3-tier SLA for intake: 24h ack, 5bd feasibility, 10bd PM decision or interim mitigation plan.
2025-10-01: Agreed to pilot scoring rubric for two accounts (Acme Health, NovaFin) during Oct cycle; telemetry dashboard to be created for visibility.
comments: 2025-09-14 - Marco D.: Drafted intake form template for CSMs to capture use case, estimated value, and compliance needs. Link in attachments.
2025-09-20 - Priya S. (Solutions Eng): We need a fast spike to validate KV-cache/serving runtime changes for Acme Health; estimated 3d impact assessment.
2025-09-27 - Sales Ops: Requested add-on that ties escalation to contract renewal windows; added as optional field in the intake form.
2025-10-02 - Aisha P.: Kickoff with two pilot accounts scheduled; metrics for pilot defined in acceptance_criteria below.
acceptance_criteria: Intake form completeness >= 80% for pilot escalations (validated by CSM)
Feasibility check returned with clear technical blockers or a mitigation plan within 5 business days
PM decision (Implement / Defer / Product workaround / Contract concession) recorded in Linear and communicated to customer within 10 business days
Pilot: 2 VIP escalations processed end-to-end during Oct with SLA compliance and post-mortem writeups
Dashboard surfaces time-to-ack, time-to-feasibility, decision outcome, and projected ARR impact for each escalation
scorecard_definition: Composite score (0-100) used to rank VIP escalation candidates. Components: ARR impact (normalized) 40%, Churn risk 25%, Strategic alignment to roadmap OKRs 15%, Implementation complexity penalty (-) 10%, Customer advocacy / reference value 10%. Example: Score = 0.4*ARR_norm + 0.25*churn + 0.15*strategy - 0.1*complexity + 0.1*advocacy. Scores > 70 => high-priority, 50-70 => mid, <50 => low.
runbook_actions: CSM: Submit VIP escalation via the new intake form and attach renewal timeline and customer P0 examples.
Product (PM): Validate strategic fit within 48 hours and assign PM owner; if ambiguous, escalate to Head of PM.
Solutions Eng: Perform technical feasibility spike within 5 business days and list required infra/work changes and risks.
Legal/Security: If escalation includes data residency or encryption asks, Legal/Security to provide initial gating review within 7 business days.
Eng Lead: Provide ballpark effort and rough ETA (T-shirt sizing) for planning; if >3 sprints, flag as large-investment candidate.
CS Ops: Track escalation in a dedicated dashboard and notify sales execs at each SLA milestone.
